title: Houston wind -> CF returns
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Houston daily max wind 10d z-score > 1.5 leads CF log returns by 1 day (+) via Gulf Coast ammonia plant outage risk; trade long CF 3d [weather.houston.wind_max -> finance.CF.log_return]

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.houston.wind_max rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long CF next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 10 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Houston daily max wind 20d z-score > 1 leads CF absolute returns (volatility) by 3 days (+) via Gulf Coast ammonia outage uncertainty rather than direction; trade long CF straddle-proxy 5d [weather.houston.wind_max -> finance.CF.abs_return] (parent: R2-0051)
